gates.deliverable: Repeatable paired symbol contrasts on a specified weak panel; raw format and instability counted separately.
gates.if_not_met: Report the collision or unresolved cell. Do not relabel a format change as separation.

gates.deliverable: Disjoint site discovery and evaluation; specific, stable, opportunity-matched reference and control evidence.
gates.if_not_met: Keep the reference undefined, unstable or unverified. Do not turn it into a zero or a mechanism label.

gates.deliverable: Resolution target, collision guard and measured coverage/width. Equal observed orbits cannot justify conflicting unique estimates.
gates.if_not_met: Return a class, interval or abstention; redesign Q or coarsen the estimand under a new contract.

gates.deliverable: Ancestry-aware whole-cluster holdout and target-blind profile predictions scored against independently measured references.
gates.if_not_met: Report within-panel discrimination only, not cross-model measurement.

gates.deliverable: Locked answers on fresh discriminatory challenges, comparator disagreements and the separate frozen cluster-macro prospective gate.
gates.if_not_met: If all simple rules agree, mark that contrast non-discriminating even at perfect accuracy.

gates.deliverable: Independent support, risk/coverage and drift validation before any calibrated or deployed attribution claim.
gates.if_not_met: Withhold attribution or probabilities and retain an output-level audit.

next_design.before_challenge: Require stable support from at least two distinct OSS lineages; commit all candidate sets, comparator answers and disagreement masks before any endpoint challenge request.
next_design.stop: No support or no singleton disagreement with any simple predictor: record abstention or non-discriminating design. No challenge dispatch or prompt search to rescue it.
